title: Total US mail volume (billion pieces)

source.name: USPS annual and year-end financial results

notes: USPS total mail volume peaked at 213 billion pieces in FY2006, fell to 129.2 billion by FY2020, and continued down to 112.5 billion in FY2024 (-3.2% year over year) and 109 billion in FY2025 -- a decline of nearly half from the peak.
